title: envelope_budget
description: Resource ceilings for the simulation agent: wall clock, storage, and a separate smoke budget. Split out of envelope_safety on 2026-09-20 because the grade of harm differs -- get the laser ceiling wrong and you lose an eye, get the wall clock wrong and you lose a night -- and the same lock on the same door was never decided. Splitting does not remove the gate: A5 and the operator still read one place, and a run that cannot tell whether it is inside budget still stops, because P0's stop-on-ambiguity binds resources too. What goes away is the physical-confirmation requirement and Tier 3, both of which were meaningless about a disk quota. There is no safety.json in this tree (plan.md §7).

policy_version.description: Recorded into every run log as safety_policy_version; raise it whenever a ceiling moves, or the record cannot be read back.

agent.description: Kept so check 5 can compare the declaration against the tree the file was found in. A schema cannot see a misplaced file; a path check can.

limit.description: A resource ceiling. Value and unit only, like a safety limit -- it is a decision and not a claim about the world, so P2's four parts do not apply (5.3.1). What it does NOT carry is `confirmation`: P0 rule 7 binds `safety.*` and not this file. Putting a power meter in a beam and knowing a machine's job limit are different acts, and demanding physical confirmation of the second writes a requirement nobody can satisfy.

unit.description: must be in units.json with a fixed SI factor, or si() refuses it

chosen_by.description: Who chose it and when. This is what replaces `confirmation` here, and it is a lower bar on purpose: what a budget needs is that somebody who knows that machine picked the number, not that anyone measured it. Required, because a ceiling nobody will own is a ceiling nobody will raise when it pinches -- and the failure mode of an unowned budget is someone quietly working around it.

rationale.description: why this number rather than another. Optional, and the first thing a later reader wants.

smoke_budget.description: Separate because a smoke run allowed the full budget tells you nothing before the run it precedes. Each of its two is a ceiling in its own right and carries its own chosen_by.
